businessGoal: Enable users to filter items by category efficiently.

scenarios.goal: User applies a filter by selecting a category and items are displayed accordingly.
User attempts to filter by a non-existent category and sees an empty result set.
User removes the category filter and is returned to the original list of items.

outOfScope: Edge cases for category input not specified in the acceptance criteria.
clarifications: What happens when no category is selected for filtering.

manual.reason: The story involves user interaction with filters, which requires manual testing.

api.reason: The filtering behavior can reasonably be validated through the API.

ui.reason: The acceptance criteria involve visible browser behavior related to filtering.
